editorHeapAfterLoadMB.why: Editor renderer only. Measured 176-178 MB on the 48-screen board in full Chromium; a pre-fix build loaded at 652 MB.

editorHeapEndMB.why: Editor renderer only. Measured 472 MB after 4 rounds; a pre-fix build reached 1,982 MB.

editorHeapGrowthPerIterationMB.why: Editor renderer only. Measured 24 MB per round after warm-up; a pre-fix build grew ~320 MB.

totalHeapEndMB.why: Every renderer, previews included. Measured 545 MB after 4 rounds, 73 MB of it in the preview renderer.

visibleRefreshes.why: A visible screen never goes blank while its preview and editor swap.

liveEditorsAfterSettle.why: At most three warm editors plus the active one; measured 2-3 because only the last visit's editors are running when the session zooms out. More means the pool leaks.
